report_metadata.title: OMNIVERSEOS 2.0 MASTER FORENSIC AUDIT & RELEASE GATE VERIFICATION REPORT

executive_summary.rationale: Zero P0 defects, zero P1 defects unresolved. All 32 desktop applications verified via live browser automation with zero crash boundaries. All 32 mobile applications verified across 5 responsive viewports with zero horizontal overflow. Windows Phone mobile revamp verified 100% operational. Pytest backend suite verified (30 passed, 1 skipped out of 31 total; skipped test is test_ai_image due to unconfigured Gemini API key; new test_image_engine.py asserts Motor truth-value resilience). Jest frontend suite passing 100% (20 suites, 82 passed). Raw AI evaluations reconciled: 121 passed, 15 factual unverifiable without web key, 14 not applicable, 0 failed. Real media bytes verified: 26,471 B JPEG and 176,444 B WAV. Production e2e verified: 8/8 flows passing on https://omniverseos.in.net and Render backend with durable MongoDB persistence. DEF-001 through DEF-007 resolved. Release is CONDITIONAL on providing TINYFISH_API_KEY for live web search.

release_gates.gate_0_core_stability: PASSED (FastAPI port 8001, React port 3000, production build clean)
release_gates.gate_2_responsive_forensics: PASSED (5 viewports, 32 apps, zero overflow, Windows Phone Metro verified)
release_gates.gate_3_automated_regressions: PASSED (82/82 Jest pass, 30/31 Pytest pass with 1 skipped)
release_gates.gate_4_durable_persistence: PASSED (Production Render verified connected to durable MongoDB Atlas; 0a353f9c probe verified)
release_gates.gate_5_live_web_search: BLOCKED (TINYFISH_API_KEY unconfigured; local knowledge fallback active)

release_gates.gate_7_production_e2e: PASSED (8/8 production flows verified on https://omniverseos.in.net with strict CORS)
